clues.it: Olga era nella 4ª colonna, in una stanza diversa da Rosa e sul Ponte.
clues.en: Olga was in the 4th column, in a different room from Rosa and on the Deck.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 1ª colonna, accanto a un barile e in una stanza diversa da Giada.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 1st column, beside a barrel and in a different room from Giada.

clues.it: Sergio era accanto a un barile e da solo in Cabina, ma non era accanto a un salvagente.
clues.en: Sergio was beside a barrel and alone in the Cabin, but was not beside a life ring.

clues.it: Dario era nella 7ª colonna, nella 4ª riga e a nord di Giada.
clues.en: Dario was in the 7th column, in the 4th row and north of Giada.

clues.it: Giada era esattamente una riga a nord di Tea e in Plancia, ma non era accanto a una pianta.
clues.en: Giada was exactly one row north of Tea and on the Bridge, but was not beside a plant.

clues.it: Tea era accanto a una pianta e a nord di Rosa.
clues.en: Tea was beside a plant and north of Rosa.

clues.it: Paolo era a nord di Rosa e in Stiva.
clues.en: Paolo was north of Rosa and in the Hold.

clues.it: Elena era nella 8ª riga e a ovest di Sergio.
clues.en: Elena was in the 8th row and west of Sergio.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

general_clues.en: 4 in the west half of the grid.
4 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Olga lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: Olga's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 4th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Fabio lascia una sola casella libera: riga 2ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: Fabio's own clue leaves a single free square: row 2nd, column 1st.

steps.it: L'indizio di Sergio lascia una sola casella libera: riga 3ª, colonna 9ª.
steps.en: Sergio's own clue leaves a single free square: row 3rd, column 9th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Dario lascia una sola casella libera: riga 4ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: Dario's own clue leaves a single free square: row 4th, column 7th.

steps.it: Giada può stare solo nella 5ª riga.
steps.en: Giada can only be in the 5th row.

steps.it: Tea può stare solo nella 6ª riga.
steps.en: Tea can only be in the 6th row.

steps.it: Dario può stare solo nella 7ª colonna: escludendola, a Giada resta una sola casella: riga 5ª, colonna 5ª.
steps.en: Dario can only be in the 7th column: ruling it out leaves Giada a single square: row 5th, column 5th.

steps.it: Giada può stare solo nella 5ª colonna: escludendola, a Tea resta una sola casella: riga 6ª, colonna 2ª.
steps.en: Giada can only be in the 5th column: ruling it out leaves Tea a single square: row 6th, column 2nd.

steps.it: Escludendo la 6ª riga di Tea, a Paolo resta una sola casella: riga 7ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Ruling out Tea's 6th row leaves Paolo a single square: row 7th, column 3rd.

steps.it: Paolo può stare solo nella 3ª colonna: escludendola, a Elena resta una sola casella: riga 8ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: Paolo can only be in the 3rd column: ruling it out leaves Elena a single square: row 8th, column 6th.

steps.it: Elena può stare solo nella 6ª colonna: escludendola, a Rosa resta una sola casella: riga 9ª, colonna 8ª.
steps.en: Elena can only be in the 6th column: ruling it out leaves Rosa a single square: row 9th, column 8th.
